title: Problem-scoped memory keeps raw project and person ids, never writes on a read, and keeps a deleted project's base ledger
request: The owner asked to fix the reviewer's confirmed findings on problem-scoped active memory (7d5751bd), skipping finding 10 (a PostgreSQL table for bases and summaries).
spec: Fix findings 1-9, 11, 13-15 of the review with a test each; no dclab_core change; regenerate the API client when the API models change.
plan: fix scope ids and the workspace helper
lock problem binding and stop reads from writing
purge by raw project id with a kept ledger
record bindings, conflicts and stale marks

decisions.decision: Person, project and session scope ids are raw ids; only the problem scope keeps dclab_core's composite key
decisions.why: the store is already one workspace's; the prefix hid every item written before (project notes, hand-off facts, preferences)

decisions.decision: A problem keeps the workspace it was bound in as part of its key (AuthorizedScope.problem_workspace)
decisions.why: a folder workspace moved to PostgreSQL would otherwise lose its Problem Base and problem items

decisions.decision: A document stamped with no workspace or 'local' belongs to the store it was read from
decisions.why: the store already holds one workspace's documents; only another named workspace refuses

decisions.decision: resolve_scope and resolve_problem never create a problem by default; only a writer's write does
decisions.why: a read (and a viewer) must not write the project outside the graph validator

decisions.decision: Problem binding runs inside the store's own turn lock
decisions.why: both stores' turn is re-entrant with their update, so the read-modify-write cannot lose a concurrent one

decisions.decision: Bindings, conflicts and stale marks reuse decision.accepted and decision.refused
decisions.why: no new experience kind (dclab_core) was needed; point names say what it was

decisions.decision: Undoing a correction writes a memory item that says it was restored at its revision
decisions.why: an item's id is the hash of its words and retirement is final; the base keeps the person's own words

decisions.decision: The worker revalidates a job's person only when sign-in is on
decisions.why: without accounts a job carries no person; the check would refuse every local job

change: dclab_rnd/memory/scope.py, bases.py, summary.py, tools.py, __init__.py (project_of); dclab_rnd/experience/retention.py; dclab_rnd/agentic/routers/memory.py; dclab_rnd/agentic/api_models.py (solution_note) and the generated api.js; dclab_rnd/draft/api.py, case_home.py, memory.py; dclab_rnd/intern/loop.py (AccessDenied around the brief's chain); dclab_rnd/jobs/worker.py; tests/test_problem_memory_active.py; tests/test_problem_memory_review_fixes.py.

findings.defect: Deleting a project left its Problem Base, summary and fact events (file mode).
findings.scenario: forget with the workspace's real log (w...) while bases and summaries were keyed 'local'; memory.written had project=None.
findings.cause: purge matched the workspace id; problem items were not linked to a project
findings.fix: purge and invalidate_summary match the raw project id; memory events link problem items to their project
findings.test: tests/test_problem_memory_review_fixes.py ProblemsAndBasesTests; tests/test_problem_memory_active.py purge test with a real log

findings.defect: Existing memory was invisible on any workspace not named 'local', and a person got a 403 reviewing their own preference.
findings.scenario: a store with workspace_id 'wabc': the chain asked for 'wabc:pid' and 'wabc:dana' while writers wrote raw ids.
findings.cause: the commit prefixed project and person ids with the workspace
findings.fix: raw ids for project, person and session; composite only for problem

findings.defect: The owner's Admin session with DCLAB_AUTH off got a 403.
findings.scenario: Principal(role owner, via admin) and GET /api/memory.

findings.defect: Projects stamped workspace_id 'local' broke after a move to PostgreSQL (AccessDenied in the intern brief).
findings.scenario: a project and problem stamped 'local' served by a store going by 'wabc123'.
findings.cause: the project document was stamped and compared strictly
findings.fix: no stamp on the project; missing or 'local' is the store's own; the intern brief catches AccessDenied

findings.defect: Home and the API used different workspace ids.
findings.scenario: Home took the principal's workspace, the router the services', the build the store's.
findings.fix: scope.workspace_of(store) used by the router, tools, build, Home and the hand-off

findings.defect: revalidate_job_scope was never called, and its default checker called a nonexistent account function.
findings.scenario: a member removed after queueing a job, with sign-in on.
findings.cause: dead code and a wrong API (members returns 'id')
findings.fix: live_membership uses Accounts(url).role_of; the worker revalidates before running when sign-in is on

findings.defect: ensure_default_problem and create_problem lost an update under concurrency.
findings.scenario: two first reads of a legacy project at once left two problems, then an ambiguous project.

findings.defect: GET routes wrote the project, also for a viewer, outside the graph validator.
findings.scenario: a viewer's GET /problems and GET summary on a legacy project.
findings.cause: auto_create_legacy defaulted to True on reads
findings.fix: reads never create (NoProblemError, 409 no_problem); only a writer's write route or the build creates, recorded

findings.defect: expected_revision was optional on the HTTP base routes.
findings.scenario: a POST without it overwrote without the optimistic check.
findings.fix: the four write routes return 422 when it is missing, before any write

findings.defect: Purge deleted the base ledger permanently.
findings.scenario: forget on a project with a Problem Base.
findings.fix: the ledger moves to bases/purged/ with a tombstone, hidden from reads; only summaries and vectors are deleted

findings.defect: Problem creation and binding, base conflicts and stale marks left no record.
findings.scenario: a conflict 409 and a correction that made a draft stale.
findings.cause: not wired (see the change and its test)
findings.fix: decision.accepted (problem.created, problem.bound) and decision.refused (revision_conflict, stale_dependency) under the raw project id

findings.defect: A prediction_moment correction in the Problem Base never reached the signed solution, silently.
findings.scenario: correct prediction_moment; the next run used the solution's old moment.
findings.cause: the base and the solution are separate
findings.fix: solution_note on a change to prediction_moment, target or forbidden (the solution is not changed here)

findings.defect: WRITE_ROLES had nonexistent roles and reviewer writes the Router denies; undoing a correction returned 422.
findings.scenario: a reviewer edited a base; A to B to A was refused.
findings.cause: hand-written role set; retired item ids are final
findings.fix: WRITE_ROLES and READ_ROLES from accounts.roles; a restored value gets a memory item saying so

outcome: Fixed findings 1-9, 11 and 13-15; finding 10 (a PostgreSQL table for bases and summaries) skipped as asked. The 13 listed test files and the new one pass.
lessons: A scope key is an identity: changing its shape hides everything written under the old shape.
A read path that can write must be closed by default, not by each caller.
Test deletion with the workspace's real log, not a double with the id the code expects.
risks: Stale marks are recorded as decision.refused; a dedicated experience kind would be clearer (dclab_core).
Bases and summaries stay files beside a PostgreSQL workspace (finding 10).
Case Home without installed services builds its scope without the host's project check.
